entrance: The main gate of Stratholme at the end of the stone bridge in the northwest of the Eastern Plaguelands. It leads straight into the Living side.

5848.objective: Find the painting Of Love and Family in the Scarlet Bastion. It hangs behind the Unfinished Painting in the room of Archivist Galford.
5848.note: First do the quests of Tirion Fordring at Thondroril River: Redemption, Of Forgotten Memories and Of Lost Honor. Artist Renfray is a ghost in a house on Caer Darrow.

5214.objective: Kill Ezra Grimm in front of his tobacco shop and bring back Grimm's Premium Tobacco.
5214.note: From the main gate, follow the street to the left to a dead end. In the Forever data the quest still carries its old name.

5251.objective: Kill Archivist Galford and burn the Scarlet Archive, the book on the table behind him.
5251.note: Leave Balnazzar alive if you want to do the follow-up in the same run.

5262.objective: Bring the Head of Balnazzar to Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff at Light's Hope Chapel.
5262.note: Only drops after you have turned in The Archivist. The chain continues with Above and Beyond on the Undead side.

5122.objective: Loot the Medallion of Faith from Malor's Strongbox in the Scarlet Bastion and bring it to Aurius.
5122.note: Aurius stands in the chapel at the start of the Undead side. The follow-up is Aurius' Reckoning.

5282.objective: Use Egan's Blaster on 15 Ghostly or Spectral Citizens, then again on the Restless Soul that appears.
5282.note: Do not kill the ghosts. First do the quest of the same name for Caretaker Alen, south of Light's Hope Chapel.
